name: Jack's Parkour Entry Between Buildings
description: Jack sprints across the rooftop, leaps to the adjacent building, and lands in a roll before climbing through an open window.
related_events: Jack performs parkour to leap between two buildings and enter through a window

name: North Enters Through Rooftop and Chimney
description: North moves quickly across the rooftop, reaches the chimney, and drops down through it, descending into the house.
related_events: North crosses rooftop and descends through chimney

name: North Pulls Two Teeth and Celebrates
description: North pulls two teeth at the same time, one with each hand, and lets out a sharp cry of triumph: 'Yipa!!'
related_events: North extracts two teeth simultaneously
North celebrates twin extraction with exclamation

name: Guardians Fly Over Middle Eastern City in North's Sleigh
description: The Guardians ride through the night sky in North's sleigh, gliding above a Middle Eastern city bathed in the glow of the full moon. The city's rooftops and minarets pass below as the sleigh moves steadily forward, carrying the group together across the darkened landscape.
related_events: Guardians travel over Middle Eastern city in North's sleigh

name: Jack Zaps Bunny with Frost After Laughter
description: Bunny holds the tooth in his paw and laughs. Jack responds by sending a burst of frost from his staff, striking Bunny, who cries out in pain and surprise.
related_events: Jack zaps Bunny with frost from his staff

name: Fairies Arrive at Tooth's Palace
description: Hundreds of fairies fly through the air, gliding in unison toward a towering, hollowed-out mountain. They approach the grand structure, its intricate openings glowing with soft light, and stream inside, filling the vast chambers with movement and sound.
related_events: Fairies fly toward Tooth's palace

name: Arrival Above the City and North's Laughter
description: North and the Guardians burst out of a wormhole in North's sleigh, soaring into the sky above the city. As the sleigh glides over the urban landscape, North throws his head back and laughs loudly, the sound carrying through the air as they continue their flight.
related_events: North and the Guardians emerge from wormhole in sleigh
North laughs while flying over city

name: Fairy Exchanges Tooth for Coin Under Pillow
description: A little fairy flies above the head of a sleeping child. She dips down, slips under the pillow, and takes a tooth from beneath it. Then she places a coin in the same spot and emerges from under the pillow, holding the tooth.
related_events: Fairy retrieves tooth from under child's pillow
Fairy leaves coin under child's pillow

name: Reveal the Hidden Fortress of Santa Claus
description: Fiery gypsy violin music swells as the camera glides through drifting clouds, revealing a vast ice canyon carved into the frozen landscape. The path winds around a sharp bend, and there, nestled within the glacial walls, rises the towering fortress of North—its icy spires glinting under the pale light, a stronghold hidden from the world.
related_events: Revelation of Santa Claus's hidden fortress in ice canyon

name: Evasion in the Underground
description: Easter eggs burst from the soil, their tiny legs scrambling to carry them out of harm's way. Nearby, a dimly-lit figure hurtles through a network of underground tunnels, darting swiftly from side to side, leaping over obstacles, and vanishing around sharp turns as something fast and unseen rushes closer.
related_events: Easter eggs emerge from the ground and move quickly
Dimly-lit figure races through underground tunnels

name: Pitch Confronts the Moon
description: Pitch steps out from an alley into the street, moving carefully to stay out of the moonlight. He looks up at the Moon and speaks to it, his voice filled with defiance. 'Don't look at me like that, old friend. You must have known this day would come. My Nightmares are finally ready. Are your Guardians?'
related_events: Pitch emerges from alley avoiding moonlight
Pitch speaks to the Moon with defiance

name: Bunny Uncovers Hidden Items and Teases Jack
description: Bunny pulls his hand out from under a pillow, revealing several teeth. He shifts the pillow aside to uncover hockey trophies, posters, and other paraphernalia scattered beneath. Looking on with a grin, he says to Jack, 'Looks like you're a bit of a brumby, hey mate.'
related_events: Bunny reveals teeth hidden under a pillow
Bunny reveals hockey trophies and paraphernalia
Bunny comments on Jack's brumby nature

name: Bunny Finds the Note and Sees North at the Window
description: Bunny pulls a note from under a pillow where a tooth should have been. The note bears an arrow pointing toward the window. He looks up and sees North outside, holding a tooth aloft with a grin. North leaps from the windowsill, laughing as he disappears into the night.
related_events: Bunny retrieves note from under pillow
North displays tooth from outside window
North leaps from window ledge laughing

name: The Call from the Spire
description: From the highest spire of North's fortress, a pulse of Northern Light Energy flares to life, casting a radiant glow across the sky. After decades of silence, the Guardians' Call echoes outward, carrying across distances long untouched. One by one, the Guardians receive the signal and begin to converge, drawn toward a gathering not seen in generations.
related_events: Northern Light Energy radiates from fortress spire
Guardians' Call goes out after decades of silence
related_occasions: Guardians Emergency Assembly Summoned By North

name: BunnyMund Emerges and Trudges Through the Snow
description: A hole opens in the snow, and BunnyMund, a six-foot-tall rabbit, climbs out, brushing snow off his fur with annoyance. He shivers immediately, muttering about the cold, and begins slogging through the deep snow. His feet numb from the freezing temperature, he continues forward, making slow progress toward North's palace, which stands in the distance, built into the side of an ice mountain and dimly lit with ornate decorations.
related_events: BunnyMund emerges from a hole in the snow
BunnyMund struggles through freezing snow

name: Bunny Lights the Fireplace and Laughs in the Firelight
description: Bunny uses his paw to ignite the fireplace, sparking a flickering fire that casts shifting light across the room. The flames glow in his eyes as he grins, then throws his head back with a loud, booming laugh.
related_events: Bunny lights the fireplace
Bunny grins in the firelight
Bunny laughs loudly in the fireplace glow

name: Jack Confronts the Rabbit Hole
description: Jack approaches an open window with a confident demeanor. As he looks inside, a hole suddenly opens in the bedroom floor. A rabbit emerges from the hole and hops into view. Jack's smile fades at the sight.
related_events: Jack arrives outside an open window with confidence
Rabbit hole opens in the bedroom floor
Bunny emerges from the rabbit hole
Jack's smile disappears upon seeing the rabbit hole

name: Jack Arrives in Burgess
description: Jack falls through the clouds, smiling as he descends toward the town of Burgess. He lands and immediately surges forward, racing through the streets. As he speeds along, gusts of wind, snow, and streaks of frost trail behind him. Pedestrians clutch their jackets and grab at their hats, bracing against the sudden chill and flurry.
related_events: Jack falls through the clouds toward Burgess
Jack zooms through the streets of Burgess
Gusts of wind and snow disrupt pedestrians

name: Tooth Finds a Mouse with the Tooth
description: Tooth reaches under a pillow and pulls out a tooth with a mouse attached to the other end. Baby Tooth lunges at the mouse and tackles it. Tooth steps in, holding up a hand and saying, 'Whoa, whoa, whoa! Take it easy there, champ! He's one of us! Part of the European division.' Then, turning to the mouse, Tooth says, 'Ca va?' The mouse responds by making an angry gesture.
related_events: Tooth retrieves mouse-attached tooth from under pillow
Baby Tooth tackles the mouse
Tooth calms Baby Tooth and identifies mouse as ally
Tooth greets mouse in French
Mouse responds with angry gesture

name: Pitch Rises Amid Fear at the Campfire
description: A family huddles around a crackling campfire, their faces lit by the flickering flames. Suddenly, a dark shadow stretches across the ground, taking the form of a looming figure. The children cling to their parent as the shadow envelops them, and their screams pierce the night. High above, the shadow flows up the side of a mountain, converging into the shape of Pitch. He stands tall, a faint smile on his lips as he gazes at the moon. His voice carries through the silence, soft and reflective, speaking of a time when fear ruled the world and he ruled with it.
related_events: Shadow resembling Pitch engulfs family at campfire
Pitch ascends mountain while smiling at moon
Pitch recalls past era of fear and power

name: Jack and the Sudden Rabbit Hole
description: Jack flies into the room through the window. A rabbit hole appears in the floor. He disappears into it. Moments later, Bunny emerges from another hole nearby, laughing to himself.
related_events: Jack flies into the room through the window
Rabbit hole appears in the room
Jack disappears into the rabbit hole

name: Bunny Emerges Laughing from Adjacent Hole
description: Jack flies in through the window and vanishes into a rabbit hole. Moments later, Bunny climbs out of another hole nearby, laughing to himself.
related_events: Bunny emerges from an adjacent hole laughing

name: North Confronts Bunny in the Rabbit Hole
description: North falls into a rabbit hole and lands in front of Bunny. He growls, stepping toward him. 'That's my tooth! Sandy! Sandy!' North shouts, his voice low and urgent. Bunny flinches, clutching his side.
related_events: North falls into a rabbit hole
North confronts Bunny after falling into the hole

name: North Confronts Sandman Over the Stolen Tooth
description: North stands beside the boy's bed, laughing softly. Sandman appears and takes the boy's tooth. North's expression shifts, and he calls out sharply, 'Sandy! Sandy!'
related_events: North laughs beside the boy's bed
Sandman takes the boy's tooth
North shouts at Sandman to stop

name: Bunny Slides Down Icy Roof After Landing with Tooth
description: Bunny lands on a rooftop, holding a tooth in his paw, his expression proud. He hears a sharp sound of ice cracking and a voice shouting 'Crikey!'—then vanishes from sight. A moment later, he reappears, sliding rapidly down the sloped roof on a sheet of ice, unable to stop his descent.
related_events: Bunny lands on rooftop holding a tooth
Bunny hears sound of ice and Frost and disappears
Bunny slides down roof on sheet of ice

name: Jack Takes the Tooth, Sandy Steals It Away
description: Bunny slid down the roof on a sheet of ice, and as he passed, Jack reached out and grabbed the tooth from his paw. Jack held the tooth high, laughing in triumph. In an instant, a hand reached in and snatched it from him. Jack turned to see Sandy waving playfully before rising into the air on a cloud made of golden sand, disappearing into the night.
related_events: Jack grabs tooth from Bunny as he slides past
Sandy snatches tooth from Jack
Sandy waves goodbye and flies off on Dreamsand cloud

name: Jack Lands in the Village
description: Jack descends and lands roughly near a cluster of simple timber houses with thatched roofs. He stumbles but quickly regains his footing, brushing himself off as a faint smile lingers on his face. The village lies quiet, with settlers gathered around campfires, their hands held out to the flames. Jack steps forward, looking around with curiosity, then calls out a greeting to a woman nearby. She does not respond. He tries again, but the townspeople pass by without acknowledging him.
related_events: Jack makes a rocky landing near a village of timber houses

name: Jack Tries to Speak to the Townspeople
description: Jack approaches a group of settlers gathered around campfires in a small village of timber houses with thatched roofs. He calls out, greeting them one by one, but no one responds. A young boy runs directly through him, passing as though he were air. Jack stumbles back, visibly shaken. The townsfolk continue moving about their evening, walking through him without notice. Jack turns away and retreats into the surrounding forest.
related_events: Jack attempts to greet townsfolk but is ignored
Young boy runs through Jack as if he were a ghost

name: Jack's Realization and the Snowfall
description: After a young boy runs through him as if he weren't there, Jack stumbles back, stunned and unable to speak. He looks around desperately as townspeople pass through him without notice. Snow begins to fall heavily around him, swirling with the wind. Shaken, Jack turns away from the village and walks into the forest.
related_events: Jack's emotional distress triggers snowfall
Jack retreats into the forest after being unrecognized

name: Jack Notices a Shadowy Figure and Is Startled
description: Jack walks along a telephone wire as the Dreamsand fades from the sky. A shadowy figure darts behind him, accompanied by an unfamiliar noise. Jack flinches and exclaims, 'Whoa!'
related_events: Jack walks along a telephone wire as Dreamsand disappears from the sky
Shadowy figure and unfamiliar noise pass behind Jack
Jack exclaims in surprise after being startled

name: Jack Chases a Shadow from Tree to Alley
description: Jack leaps from the telephone wire onto a nearby tree, scanning the area after sensing a sudden movement behind him. A shadowy figure darts past again, accompanied by an unfamiliar noise. Without hesitation, Jack jumps down from the tree and lands on a truck parked in a narrow alley, continuing his pursuit.
related_events: Jack leaps from wire to tree to investigate
Mysterious presence zips behind Jack again
Jack jumps from tree to truck in alley

name: Residents Call Out Household Oversights at Night
description: As Jack moves through the neighborhood, voices from nearby homes drift through the air. Unseen residents call out to one another about open windows and a garage door left wide open. The sounds of their routine nighttime checks fill the background as Jack leaps onto a tree and then down into an alley.
related_events: Residents prepare for night and exchange complaints off-screen

name: Sandman Commands the Dreamsand Network
description: A stream of golden sand flows from the window of a sleeping child, rising into the night sky. The sand twists and swirls as it ascends through the clouds, revealing dozens of glowing strands descending to Earth. High above, a small glowing cloud pulses among the sky, trailing the golden threads. The Sandman stands within it, guiding the strands with focused precision. A sudden signal streaks past—the Sandman turns, his expression shifting. He closes his eyes, and the cloud whirls around him, reshaping into a biplane. He climbs into the cockpit, executes a sharp barrel roll, and dives through the clouds, flying swiftly into the distance.
related_events: Dreamsand stream emerges from sleeping child's window
Camera follows Dreamsand stream into the sky
Reveal of glowing golden cloud among clouds
Sandman controls strands of Dreamsand

name: The Sandman Answers North's Call
description: North's emergency signal streaks through the sky. The Sandman sees it and his expression turns serious. In an instant, the glowing cloud of Dreamsand surrounding him swirls and reshapes into a small biplane, with Sandy seated in the cockpit. He pulls back on the controls, rolls the plane sharply, and dives through the clouds in a swift, spiraling descent. The biplane speeds away into the distance, cutting through the sky.
related_events: North's emergency signal passes by rapidly
Sandman reacts to emergency signal with concern
Sandy transforms Dreamsand cloud into a biplane
Sandy performs barrel roll and dives through cloudscape
Sandy flies off into the distance on biplane

name: Jack's Prank on Bunnymund During the Sleigh Ride
description: Jack leaps onto the rear of the sleigh, laughing as he watches the North Pole shrink behind them. He calls out to Bunnymund, pointing at the view, then suddenly yells in mock terror as he is swept off the back of the sleigh and vanishes from sight. Bunnymund gasps, peering over the edge in alarm—only to see Jack casually lounging on the sleigh's skid, grinning. Jack teases him, saying, 'Awww...you do care.' Bunnymund scowls, muttering, 'Ah, rack off you bloody show pony,' as Jack climbs back into the sleigh.
related_events: Jack leaps onto the rear of the sleigh to admire the view
Jack startles Bunny with a dramatic view comment
Jack is swept off the sleigh and disappears momentarily
Bunnymund gasps in horror upon seeing Jack missing
Jack reappears lounging on the sleigh's skid
Jack teases Bunnymund with affectionate remark

name: North Opens Magical Portal to the Tooth Palace
description: North guides the reindeer sleigh through the howling wind as it climbs higher into the sky. Holding a snow globe in his hand, he speaks the words, 'I say, Tooth Palace.' The globe glows, revealing an image of the distant palace within. He throws the globe into the air, and a massive vortex tears open before them. 'Hyah!' North shouts, urging the reindeer forward as the sleigh surges toward the swirling portal.
related_events: North guides reindeer sleigh through windy conditions
North announces shortcut using snow globe
North activates magical vortex to Tooth Palace

name: North Discovers the Black Sand on the Globe of Belief
description: North strides through the workshop as hundreds of lights on the Globe of Belief suddenly blink out. He turns to the yetis, demanding to know if the axis has been checked and whether the rotation is balanced. One yeti shrugs, offering a mumbled response, but before he can finish, a gust of wind surges through the room. A swirling mass of black sand creeps across the globe, engulfing the remaining lights in darkness.
related_events: Hundreds of lights on the Globe of Belief suddenly go out
North questions yeti about globe's axis and rotation balance
Swirling black sand spreads over the Globe of Belief

name: North Confronts the Shadow After the Globe's Darkness
description: Black sand surged upward from the Globe of Belief, bursting into smoke and vanishing into the air. Debris settled across the floor as the lights on the Globe flickered back on. A huge shadow swept across the walls and floors of the fortress, then disappeared. From the darkness came the echo of laughter. North stood frozen, staring upward, and whispered, "Can it be?"
related_events: Black sand surges upward from the Globe of Belief and dissipates
Debris settles and lights on the Globe of Belief restore
Huge shadow flashes across the fortress interior
Echo of laughter heard in the fortress after shadow disappears
North reacts with shock and questions if a threat has returned

name: North Activates Emergency Protocol After Globe Darkens
description: North pushes through a crowd of panicking elves and yeti workers as the Globe of Belief flickers and darkens under a wave of black sand. After the sand vanishes and the lights return, a massive shadow sweeps across the walls of the fortress, followed by the faint echo of laughter. North stands frozen, then sharply calls out for Dingle. A group of elves eagerly step forward, all pointing to themselves, their excitement quickly turning to confusion. Without hesitation, North announces that company is coming and strides toward a large emergency lever. He twists and presses it. The Globe pulses with energy, which surges up the axis shaft toward the roof.
related_events: North pushes past panicking elves and yeti workers
Elves respond excitedly and confusedly to North's call for Dingle
North announces preparations for incoming company
North activates the emergency lever to initiate Guardian protocol
Energy surges from the Globe of Belief up the axis shaft

name: Jack Lands and Meets Jamie by the Pond
description: Jack flies in and skates across the frozen pond, the wind from his movement knocking a book from the hands of a young boy, Jamie, who walks alone. The book falls to the ground, its cover briefly visible: 'THEY'RE OUT THERE! - MYSTERIES, MYTHICAL CREATURES AND THE UNEXPLAINED PHENOMENA.' Jamie reaches down to pick it up as Jack glides to a stop and lands beside him. Jack looks at the book and says, 'Huh, that looks interesting. Good book?'
related_events: Jack arrives and skates across the frozen pond
Wind knocks book from Jamie's hands
Jamie attempts to retrieve fallen book
Jack lands beside Jamie and comments on the book

name: Boys Celebrate Snow Day and Discuss Egg Hunt
description: Claude and Caleb run past Jack and Jamie, shoving each other into snow drifts and laughing loudly. Jack calls out, 'You're welcome!' as they pass. Jamie turns and runs after them, calling, 'Hey guys, wait up! Are you guys coming to the egg hunt Sunday?' Caleb grins and says, 'Yeah, free candy!' Claude looks around at the snow and replies, 'I hope we can find the eggs with all this snow!'
related_events: Claude and Caleb rough-house and run past Jack and Jamie
Jack calls out to the passing boys
Jamie runs after the boys and asks about the egg hunt
Caleb expresses excitement about free candy at the egg hunt
Claude worries about finding eggs due to snow cover

name: Caleb Stuffs Snow Down Claude's Jacket
description: While roughhousing on the snowy pond, Caleb grabs a handful of snow and shoves it down his brother Claude's jacket, sending them both laughing and tumbling into a snowbank.
related_events: Caleb stuffs snow down his brother's jacket

name: Tooth Directs Global Tooth Collection
description: Dozens of tiny fairies flit through a bustling hub, carrying children's teeth to rows of small wooden drawers where they are carefully stored. Coins are placed in waiting slots, ready to be delivered. Tooth hovers at the center, wings fluttering, calling out directions. 'Chicago, Sector 6 -- 37 molars, bicuspids, 18 central incisors. Moscow, Sector 9 -- 22 incisors, premolars.' A sudden weather alert interrupts the flow. 'Uh oh, heavy rain advisory!' A moment later, a new assignment comes in. 'Des Moines, we've got a cuspid at Maple. Head out!' The fairies scatter to their tasks. One Mini Tooth Fairy approaches with a small tooth. Tooth holds it up, eyes lighting with delight. 'It's her first tooth. Have you ever seen a more adorable lateral incisor in all of your life?! Look how she flossed!' The surrounding fairies chirp in amazement. Then, a sharp gasp. Above, the aurora signal pulses across the sky. Tooth turns, face serious, and shoots forward into the air, a small group of fairies following close behind.
related_events: Tooth coordinates global tooth retrieval operations from central hub
Tooth Fairy operatives collect children's teeth and distribute coins
related_occasions: Central Tooth Collection And Processing Operation

name: Tooth Discovers a Child's First Lost Tooth
description: Amid the bustling activity of the central tooth collection hub, where dozens of tiny fairies sort teeth into wooden drawers and distribute coins, Tooth suddenly calls for a halt. She holds up a small lateral incisor, her face lighting with delight. 'It's her first tooth,' she exclaims, turning it gently in her fingers. 'Have you ever seen a more adorable lateral incisor in all of your life?!' She gasps, pointing at fine floss marks. 'Look how she flossed!' The surrounding fairies chirp and flutter in excitement. Before the moment can settle, the sky flashes with North's aurora signal. Tooth's expression shifts, and without a word, she shoots upward, a small group of fairies trailing behind as she speeds toward the source.
related_events: Tooth identifies a child's first lost tooth with emotional significance
related_occasions: Central Tooth Collection And Processing Operation

name: Tooth Answers the Aurora Signal
description: Tooth turns her gaze to the sky, spotting North's AURORA SIGNAL stretching across the heavens. Her expression sharpens with recognition. Without hesitation, she launches into flight, streaking through the air with a small group of ranking fairies close behind. They soar into the distance, heading toward the North Pole, where the signal originates.
related_events: Tooth notices North's AURORA SIGNAL in the sky
Tooth flies toward the source of the AURORA SIGNAL with ranking fairies
related_occasions: Guardians Emergency Assembly Summoned By North

name: North Summons the Guardians
description: North stands at the North Pole and sends out a voiceover message that echoes across the world. His voice carries urgency as he calls all Guardians to assemble. He declares that the children of the world are in danger, and that it is their duty to protect them. The message spreads, reaching each Guardian, as the aurora lights stretch across the sky, signaling the beginning of their gathering.
related_events: North delivers urgent message to the Guardians about children being in danger
related_occasions: Guardians Emergency Assembly Summoned By North

name: Jack Frost's Icy Prank on the Street
description: A hooded figure touches a staff to the ground, sending a streak of frost across the street. The frost spreads to a water fountain where a Russian boy leans in for a drink, and the water freezes instantly, trapping his tongue. Nearby, a patch of ice forms beneath a mailman’s feet as he walks, causing him to lose his balance and fall hard onto the ground. The trail of frost continues upward, climbing the side of a building along a rain pipe.
related_events: Hooded figure sends streak of frost across the street
Russian boy's tongue gets stuck to frozen water fountain
Mailman slips on magically appearing patch of ice

name: Jack Frost's Ascent Through the City
description: A streak of frost climbs up the side of a building, tracing its way along a rain pipe. As it rises, the freezing cold spreads to clothes lines and power lines, encasing them in ice. Through a window, a boy watches as a thin layer of ice forms across his goldfish bowl, sealing the surface and preventing the fish from reaching its food. Higher up, in a writer's study, the window suddenly swings open. A sharp gust of wind bursts into the room, scattering stacks of papers and sending them flying out into the air. The frost continues its climb, moving upward across the building’s facade.
related_events: Trail of frost climbs up building along rain pipe
Clothes lines and power lines freeze along building
Ice forms on goldfish bowl, blocking fish from food
Gust of wind blows writer's papers out the window

name: Jack Frost Takes Flight
description: Jack Frost stands atop a cathedral spire, looking out over the city bathed in moonlight. He smiles, then calls to the wind. The air stirs, trees sway, and leaves swirl around him. He grips the spire for a moment before letting go, lifted into the air by the wind. It carries him upward, through layers of clouds, where the night gives way to dawn. Soaring into the light, he spreads his arms and laughs, racing across the sky as the sun rises.
related_events: Jack Frost reaches cathedral spire and observes moonlit city
Jack Frost calls the wind and begins to fly
Wind carries Jack Frost through the clouds into daylight
Jack Frost expresses exhilaration during flight

name: Rooftop Race in Shanghai
description: North bursts out of a chimney and sprints across the Shanghai rooftops, leaping from one building to the next. Bunnymund appears on a nearby roof, joining the chase. Jack zips into view and calls out to Bunnymund, teasing him about falling behind. Bunnymund retorts, challenging Jack in return. North erupts from another chimney, shouting with excitement as he joins the race, vaulting between rooftops with booming energy. He shoots out of one chimney and then another, laughing as he declares the race epic. Tooth darts into view, distracted by glowing teeth scattered across the city, and flies straight into a toothpaste billboard. Jack lands beside her, asking if she’s alright. She recovers just in time to spot a glowing tooth under a little girl’s pillow and darts off toward it, leaving Jack and Baby Tooth behind.
related_events: North dashes across Shanghai rooftops emerging from chimneys
Bunnymund joins rooftop pursuit across Shanghai skyline
Jack challenges Bunnymund during rooftop race
North enthusiastically joins race declaring it epic

name: Tooth's Return to the Field
description: Tooth darts through the city, her eyes wide with excitement and disorientation as she takes in the bright lights and constant movement. She calls out sightings—a bicuspid here, an incisor there, a molar in the distance—her voice rising with urgency as teeth appear all around. Distracted by the flurry of activity, she fails to see a large toothpaste billboard ahead and slams into it with a thud. Dazed, she rubs her head as Jack lands nearby, asking if she’s alright. She brushes it off, admitting she hasn’t been on a field run in over four centuries. Suddenly, her gaze locks onto a faint glow beneath a child’s pillow through a bedroom window. Her eyes widen, and without a word, she surges forward, darting toward the new tooth.
related_events: Tooth arrives on scene overwhelmed by city lights and traffic
Tooth identifies multiple teeth in urban environment
Tooth collides with toothpaste billboard while distracted
Tooth reveals her prolonged absence from fieldwork

name: Tooth Retrieves a Freshly Lost Tooth
description: Tooth spots a faint glow beneath a little girl's pillow through her bedroom window. Her eyes widen with recognition and excitement. Without hesitation, she darts forward, flying swiftly toward the window. Jack watches, glancing at Baby Tooth with a knowing look as Tooth focuses on the approaching house.
related_events: Tooth discovers a newly placed tooth under a little girl's pillow
Tooth flies toward a child's bedroom upon discovering a lost tooth

name: Jack and Baby Tooth Prepare for a Long Night
description: After Tooth flies off excitedly toward a glowing tooth beneath a little girl's pillow, Jack looks at Baby Tooth with a quiet expression, then glances in the direction Tooth vanished. The two remain still for a moment on the billboard as the city hums around them, then Baby Tooth flutters into motion, and Jack pushes off into the air, following Tooth into the night.
related_events: Jack anticipates a lengthy night of tooth collection

name: Sleigh Arrives Amid Nightmare Attack
description: The sleigh bursts out of hyperdrive at the edge of the Tooth Palace, plunging into chaos. Nightmares swarm through the air, lunging at fleeing Tooth Fairies and dragging them away. North yanks the reins, swerving the sleigh sharply to avoid colliding with the oncoming creatures. Sandy and Bunny duck as Nightmares streak past, narrowly missing them.
related_events: Sleigh exits hyperdrive near Tooth Palace
Nightmares attack fleeing Tooth Fairies
North maneuvers sleigh to avoid Nightmares
Sandy and Bunny dodge Nightmare onslaught

name: Jack Rescues Baby Tooth from a Nightmare Attack
description: The sleigh emerges near the Tooth Palace, where chaos unfolds as black streaks—Nightmares—swarm through the sky. They dart among the Tooth Fairies, lunging at them and swallowing them whole before speeding away. Jack watches in alarm as the Nightmares overtake the fairies in a relentless assault. He spots a single fairy fleeing, a Nightmare snapping at its heels. Without hesitation, Jack leaps from the sleigh, intercepts the creature midair, and shields the fairy. He lands back in the sleigh, opening his hand to reveal Baby Tooth, trembling but unharmed. North steers the sleigh forward, cutting through the storm of Nightmares toward the palace entrance.
related_events: Jack realizes Nightmares are capturing Tooth Fairies
Jack rescues a lone fairy from a pursuing Nightmare

name: Jack Rescues and Comforts Baby Tooth
description: After leaping from the sleigh, Jack catches a lone fairy just as a Nightmare lunges for her. He lands back aboard the sleigh and opens his hand to find Baby Tooth trembling inside. He speaks to her gently, asking if she's okay. She looks up at him and nods, still shaking.
related_events: Jack discovers Baby Tooth frightened in his hand
Jack comforts Baby Tooth after her rescue

name: North Navigates Sleigh Through Nightmare Storm to Tooth Palace
description: After rescuing Baby Tooth, North takes control of the sleigh and steers it through the chaotic swarm of Nightmares and fleeing fairies. The sleigh cuts through the storm, dodging oncoming threats as it moves steadily toward the entrance of the Tooth Palace.
related_events: North pilots the sleigh through the storm toward Tooth Palace entrance

name: Jack Frost Emerges from the Ice
description: Jack Frost rises from beneath the frozen surface of a pond, breaking through a splintered hole in the ice. He floats down gently onto the ice as the opening beneath him seals shut. Bathed in bright moonlight, he stands still, the fear that once gripped him fading. He looks around, disoriented, taking in the snow-covered trees and silent landscape, then turns his gaze upward toward the moon as its light begins to dim.
related_events: Jack Frost emerges from underwater through ice hole
Jack Frost descends onto ice surface after emergence
Jack Frost experiences moment of clarity under moonlight
Jack Frost looks around in confusion after awakening

name: Jack Discovers the Wooden Staff on the Frozen Pond
description: Jack walks across the frozen pond, his feet brushing against something hidden beneath the frost. He stops and looks down to see a wooden staff lying on the ice. He bends down and picks it up, turning it in his hands. The moment he grips it, the staff begins to glow a cold blue. Startled, he nearly drops it, but holds on as the light pulses in response to his touch.
related_events: Jack Frost discovers wooden staff on frozen pond
Jack Frost picks up wooden staff and it begins to glow

name: Jack Discovers the Staff's Frost Powers
description: Jack touches the base of the wooden staff to the ice, and frost surges outward across the pond's surface. He moves to the trees nearby, pressing the staff against their trunks, and frost climbs upward in delicate patterns. With each use, his movements grow more assured as he continues to explore the strange power in his hands.
related_events: Frost spreads across ice upon staff's contact with ground
Jack Frost sends frost up tree trunks using staff

name: Jack Swings the Staff and Is Lifted by the Wind
description: Jack swings the staff with force, and a powerful gust of wind surges from it, lifting him into the air. He floats for a moment, suspended above the frozen pond, before losing balance and falling back down, crashing into the trees at the edge of the clearing.
related_events: Jack Frost swings staff and creates gust of wind
Jack Frost floats and then falls back to earth into trees

name: Jack Climbs a Tree and Sees a Distant Town
description: After falling into the trees, Jack reaches for a branch, pulls himself up, and climbs higher until he can see beyond the treeline. In the distance, a small town comes into view, nestled among the snow-covered landscape.
related_events: Jack Frost climbs tree to view distant town

name: Dreamsand Creates a Peaceful Dream
description: Dreamsand floats through the window into Cupcake's bedroom, where she lies asleep in bed, hugging a stuffed unicorn. The golden sand swirls above her head and takes the shape of a little girl riding a unicorn. The dream image glides gently through the air, casting a soft glow around the room.
related_events: Dreamsand enters bedroom and forms dream image of girl riding unicorn

name: Pitch Rises from the Shadows and Corrupts the Dream
description: A dark, wispy figure crawls out from under the bed, rising slowly into the room. It is Pitch. He watches as golden Dreamsand swirls above Cupcake’s head, forming a small girl riding a unicorn through the air. A faint smile crosses his lips as he listens to the soft sound of hooves. 'Ohhhh, I thought I heard the clippity-clop of a unicorn,' he murmurs. 'What an adorable dream.' He leans closer to the sleeping child, his voice softening. 'And look. At. Her. Precious child. So sweet, so full of hope and wonder.' Then, with a quiet gleam in his eye, he adds, 'Why, there's only one thing missing...a touch of fear.' He reaches into the dream and presses a bony finger to the unicorn. The creature darkens, turns to ash, and crumbles away. Cupcake flinches in her sleep. Pitch laughs, swirling the now-black sand into a shadowy, snarling Nightmare horse. 'Yesss. What a pretty little Nightmare,' he whispers. He grabs its mane and sends it flying out the window, where it joins others racing across the night sky.
related_events: Pitch emerges from under the bed and observes Cupcake's dream
Pitch comments on the unicorn dream and expresses intent to add fear

name: Pitch Corrupts the Dream Unicorn
description: Pitch reaches into Cupcake's dream and touches the unicorn with his bony finger. The unicorn turns ashen and black, then disintegrates. Cupcake flinches in her sleep as the dream unravels.
related_events: Pitch corrupts the dream unicorn into ashen black fragments
Cupcake reacts to the dream corruption in her sleep

name: Pitch Turns Dreamsand into a Nightmare
description: Pitch reaches into the swirling Dreamsand above Cupcake’s bed and touches it with a bony finger. The golden sand darkens, turning black as it twists and coils under his control. He gathers the corrupted sand in his hands, shaping it into a shadowy, bucking horse with glowing eyes and jagged edges. The creature snorts and rears, fully formed. Pitch grabs its mane, grinning, then sends it surging out the window, where it joins other dark shapes flying into the night sky.
related_events: Pitch transforms Dreamsand into Nightmare sand
Pitch summons a shadowy bucking horse from Nightmare sand

name: Pitch Sends the Nightmare into the Night Sky
description: Pitch grabs the mane of the shadowy Nightmare and flings it out the window. The creature soars into the night, joining a group of other Nightmares that gallop through the streets and rise into the sky, vanishing into the darkness.
related_events: Pitch commands the Nightmare to join others in the sky

name: Jamie Recounts His Sledding Crash and Shows His Missing Tooth
description: Jamie plays with his toy robot, guiding it through the air as he reenacts a sledding jump. He mimes flying fast down a hill, weaving between cars, then suddenly soaring upward before crashing onto the bed. Sitting up, he opens his mouth to show the gap where his tooth came out. Sophie laughs and reaches toward the space in his gums. Jamie’s mom watches from nearby as the dog licks his face.
related_events: Jamie mimics a sledding crash with his toy robot
Jamie reveals a missing tooth from the crash

name: Sophie Laughs and Pokes Jamie's Tooth Gap
description: Sophie bursts into laughter as Jamie recounts how he flew through the air on his sled and lost his tooth. She leans in and playfully sticks her finger into the gap in his gums, making him pull away. Jamie's mom watches nearby as the dog licks Jamie's face, and the room fills with the sound of giggles and playful chaos.
related_events: Sophie laughs and pokes Jamie's tooth gap

name: Mom's Bedtime Routine with Jamie and Sophie
description: Jamie's mom enters the room and asks if his tooth is under the pillow. Jamie confirms it is, then shows her the camera and flashlight he has ready. She tells him not to stay up trying to see the tooth fairy, or she won’t come. Sophie laughs and tries to poke her finger into the gap in Jamie’s gums. Jamie asks if she wants to help him stay awake, and Sophie shouts excitedly, 'Hide, hide, hide, hide!' Mom picks Sophie up, lifts her over her shoulder, and carries her toward the door. The family dog gets up and licks Jamie’s face as he lies on the bed.
related_events: Jamie's mom reminds him to place the tooth under his pillow
Jamie's mom warns Jamie not to stay awake for the tooth fairy
Jamie's mom carries Sophie out of the room
The family dog licks Jamie's face

name: Jamie Reveals Hidden Camera and Flashlight
description: Jamie tells his mom he can stay awake to see the tooth fairy. He lifts his stuffed rabbit and pulls out a camera and flashlight from under his pillow. He places the items on his nightstand, ready for the night.
related_events: Jamie expresses readiness to see the tooth fairy
Jamie retrieves a hidden camera and flashlight

name: Sophie Urges Hiding Before Bed
description: Sophie jumps on the bed and shouts 'hide, hide, hide, hide!' in a burst of excitement. Jamie turns to her and asks if she wants to help. She laughs and reaches toward the gap in his gums as their dog licks his face. Their mom picks Sophie up, lifts her over her shoulder, and carries her toward the door.
related_events: Sophie excitedly urges hiding

name: Jack Frost Watches Through the Window
description: Jack Frost appears outside Jamie's window, hanging upside down and peering into the room. As he watches, the glass begins to frost over.

The window glass frosts over

name: Jack Seeks Answers from the Moon
description: Jack flips onto the roof and makes his way to its peak. He looks up at the full Moon and speaks to it, asking what he is doing wrong and why no one sees him, pleading for a sign or explanation. The Moon shines down without reply. After a moment, Jack turns away, his expression filled with frustration.

Jack speaks to the Moon seeking answers
The Moon remains silent in response to Jack's plea
Jack turns away from the Moon in frustration

name: Jack Moves Across the Telephone Wires
description: Jack turns away from the Moon and leaps from the roof onto a telephone pole. He steps onto the wires and begins walking across them, moving carefully through the town. Above him, streams of golden Dreamsand zip through the air, one passing behind him, another swooping in front. Jack turns and smiles. JACK Right on time, Sandman. He runs along the wire, reaches out, and intercepts a passing stream of sand. Nearby, another stream twists into the shape of a dolphin, turns toward him, then continues on its path toward a child's window.

Jack walks across telephone wires

name: Jack Greets the Sandman
description: A stream of golden Dreamsand zips past behind Jack. Another stream follows, swooping in front of him. Jack turns, looks up, and smiles. 'Right on time, Sandman,' he says. The Dreamsand drifts down from the sky, flowing into windows across the town.

Jack speaks to Sandman acknowledging his arrival

name: Jack Catches Dreamsand and Meets a Dolphin
description: Jack runs along a telephone wire, stretching out his staff to intercept a passing stream of golden Dreamsand. Nearby, another stream twists and takes the shape of a dolphin, which turns toward him, gliding playfully in the air before swimming off in a new direction. The Dreamsand continues on, flowing toward the windows of sleeping children.

name: Dreamsand Brings Dreams to Sleeping Children
description: Golden streams of Dreamsand drift down from the sky, weaving through the night air and slipping into open windows across the town. One stream twists and shapes itself into a dolphin as it approaches a house, then glides inside to deliver a dream to a child lying asleep. Another stream floats toward a different home, and the light follows it as it enters through a window, drifting gently into the room.

Camera follows Dreamsand stream into a window

name: Pitch Reveals the Collapse of Belief
description: Pitch stands before the Guardians, his voice laced with scorn as he watches a column in the Tooth Palace crack and crumble behind him. Dust and debris scatter as the structure decays, drawing startled eyes to the damage. Tooth stares in shock, her wings trembling. Jack steps closer to her, his expression uncertain. As the palace continues to break apart, Pitch speaks of children waking to find their baby teeth still beneath their pillows, of belief fading, and of the Guardians' powers weakening in turn. The air grows heavy with the weight of his words, and the destruction around them deepens.

name: Children Discover Their Teeth Are Still Under Their Pillows
description: Children around the world wake up and lift their pillows, finding their baby teeth still lying there. One by one, they look underneath, confused, holding the small teeth in their hands. The rooms are quiet, the morning light soft, but the usual excitement is missing. No coins, no note—just the teeth, left behind.
related_events: Children lift their pillows and find baby teeth still there

name: Pitch Flees on Onyx as Guardians Chase and Attack
description: After speaking his final words, Pitch turns as Bunny hurls boomerangs toward him. They slice through the air, missing their target as Pitch ducks and leaps onto the back of Onyx, his shadowy steed. The creature surges forward, plunging into the dark depths below the Tooth Palace. The Guardians and Jack rush after him without hesitation, diving into the chasm. Behind them, Bunny pulls out a set of egg-shaped bombs and hurls them downward. They strike the crumbling stone just below Pitch, exploding in a burst of fire and debris as the chase continues into the darkness.

name: The Guardians in Action
description: North's sleigh soars across the night sky, gliding in front of the glowing moon. High above, Tooth and her fairies dart through the air, flitting from window to window as they gather teeth. Across the world, Sandy's golden Dreamsand spirals down from the heavens, weaving gentle sleep into the night. Meanwhile, Bunny bounds swiftly across rooftops, his powerful leaps carrying him from house to house.
related_events: North's sleigh flies in front of the moon
Tooth and her fairies flit by

Bunny leaps across rooftops

name: Pitch Fades into the Shadows After Being Ignored by Children
description: A thin and weakened Pitch stands in the street as children run through him, laughing and playing, unaware of his presence. He steps back, silent and unseen, and disappears into the darkness of the shadows.
related_events: Pitch slips back into the shadows after children run through him

name: Shadow Startles Jack, Who Flees to the Clearing
description: A shadow streaks through the alley, knocking over a trash can with a loud clatter. Jack, startled, jumps down from the truck and backs quickly out of the alley into an open clearing.
related_events: Shadow dashes past and knocks over trash can
Jack jumps down from truck and retreats from alley

name: BunnyMund Confronts Jack in the Clearing
description: From the shadows, a voice calls out. Jack spins around, raising his staff in defense. Into the light steps BunnyMund, tall and calm, his ears twitching slightly as he regards Jack. "Been a long time. Blizzard of '68, I believe? Easter Sunday, wasn't it?" Jack frowns, caught off guard. "Bunny? You're not still mad about that... are yah?" BunnyMund's eyes narrow, and he pulls out a boomerang, turning it slowly in his hands. "Yes," he says. "But this is about something else."
related_events: BunnyMund greets Jack from off-screen
Jack turns and prepares to attack
BunnyMund recalls past encounter from 1968
Jack expresses confusion and concern about BunnyMund's anger

name: BunnyMund Draws Boomerang and Reveals a New Threat
description: BunnyMund draws his boomerang and casually inspects it in his hands. Jack tenses, recognizing the gesture as a sign of danger. BunnyMund looks up and says the current situation is not about their past conflict. He then calls out to unseen allies, shifting the focus away from their history and toward something more urgent.
related_events: BunnyMund draws boomerang and inspects it
BunnyMund indicates current matter is unrelated to past grudge

name: Yetis Capture Jack and Place Him in a Sack

Two yetis grab Jack and shove him into a sack

name: The Portal and the Rabbit Hole
description: A yeti smashes a snow globe on the ground, and a magical portal springs open. BunnyMund steps back, refusing to enter. He stamps his foot twice, causing a rabbit hole to swirl open beneath him. He leaps in and vanishes, leaving behind a small green plant that grows from the spot. The yetis lift the sack containing Jack and throw it through the portal. They charge in after him, disappearing as the portal closes behind them.
related_events: Yeti smashes snow globe to open magic portal
BunnyMund declines entering magic portal and creates rabbit hole
BunnyMund leaps into rabbit hole and disappears
Yetis throw Jack through magic portal and follow

name: Jamie Opens the Secret Plank
description: The kids arrive at the fence of Jamie's house. Jamie lifts a hidden plank and steps into his yard. Claude and Caleb stand at the gate, arguing back and forth. Jack walks silently along the top of the fence, unseen by the others.

name: Jamie Shares Big Foot News
description: Jamie arrives at his front gate with his sled, excitedly reading about Big Foot hair samples and DNA found in Michigan. He tells the others that Big Foot is real, pointing out how close the discovery was. Claude rolls his eyes and says, 'Here we go again.' Caleb chimes in, reminding Jamie that he said the same thing about aliens and the Easter Bunny. Jamie grins and insists, 'Wow, the Easter Bunny is real!' Sophie, sitting on the family Greyhound in her fairy wings, giggles and shouts, 'EASTER BUNNY! HOP-HOP-HOP!' before falling over and starting to cry. Jamie calls for his mom as Claude laughs and asks if they’re going sledding.

Claude mocks Jamie's belief in Big Foot
Caleb references Jamie's past false claims about aliens and the Easter Bunny
Jamie claims the Easter Bunny is real

description: Sophie giggles and shouts 'EASTER BUNNY! HOP-HOP-HOP!' as she hops in her fairy wings. She loses her balance, falls to the ground, and begins to cry. Jamie calls out, 'Mom! Sophie fell again!' Jamie's mom comes outside and asks, 'You okay, Soph?'

name: Jamie Questions Jack Frost While the Kids Prepare to Sled
description: Claude asks if they are going sledding, and Jamie's mom steps outside, placing a hat on Jamie's head to keep him warm. She tells him they don't want Jack Frost nipping at his nose. Jamie looks up and asks who Jack Frost is. His mom smiles and says it's just an expression. Nearby, Caleb and his brother stand at the front gate, calling out to Jamie as the kids gather in the yard.

description: After being dismissed as just an expression, Jack jumps down from the fence. He scoops up a handful of snow from the ground and shapes it into a perfect snowball using his magic. He then blows his icy breath onto it, and the snowball turns a light shade of blue.

description: Jack hops down from the top of the fence and walks into the yard, moving among the children as they play. He leans over their shoulders, watching them argue and laugh. When Jamie excitedly claims the Easter Bunny is real, Jack rolls his eyes and mutters, 'Oh he's real alright. Real annoying, real grumpy, and really full of himself.' Sophie giggles and shouts 'EASTER BUNNY! HOP-HOP-HOP!' before falling over and starting to cry.

description: North uses tongs to slam a block of ice onto a stone work table. He grabs a chainsaw and cuts the block in half, sending shards of ice spraying. As he lifts the chainsaw, the word NAUGHTY on his arm tattoo becomes visible.

description: North hunches over the ice block, a jeweler's eyepiece fixed over one eye, magnifying his intense blue gaze. He hums softly to himself as he guides a delicate chiseling tool across the surface, carving fine details with steady hands. As he works, the sleeve of his arm shifts, revealing a tattoo that reads 'NICE.' Once finished, he lifts the completed ice locomotive and places it carefully onto a curving track.

description: The ice locomotive chugs down the curving track, belching vapor as it gains speed. It hits a loop and soars into the air. North chuckles, biting into a cookie as he watches. Midflight, wings unfold from the locomotive and jet engines ignite, propelling it forward. North's face lights up. 'Yes!' he exclaims, watching the train soar.

description: North calls out for cookies as he crosses the room. He launches himself across the floor on a rolling chair, grabs a miniature hammer from his work tools, and hums while chiseling details into a block of ice. Nearby, three elves huddle around a plate of cookies, each eating. When North approaches, they freeze in fear. One elf lowers its half-eaten cookie, unfurls its tongue, and lets the chewed pieces spill back onto the plate. North takes a cookie from the plate they hold and bites into it, then turns his attention to the ice track where his locomotive begins to move.

description: The door bursts open as a yeti rushes in, sending the ice locomotive skidding across the floor in pieces. The yeti immediately covers its mouth, trembling with shame. North stares at the shattered toy, his face twisted in dismay. He turns to the yeti and scolds him sharply for not knocking. The yeti responds with urgent, frantic cries, gesturing toward the Globe. North's expression shifts. In one swift motion, he draws a large scimitar from its sheath and strides out.

description: North shoves open a set of double doors, stepping into the hangar with Bunny, Sandy, and Jack close behind. Yetis rush around, preparing the hangar for launch. North calls out to the Yetis, urging them to finish quickly. The sound of pounding hooves and snorting fills the air as Santa's sleigh comes into view—a massive, gleaming, high-speed sled that skids to a stop in front of them. North speaks to the reindeer in a calming voice, telling them to quiet down. The group moves to board the sleigh as the Yetis continue their final preparations.

description: Jack protests as he follows North through the double doors, refusing to join the journey. His resistance falters when Santa's massive, gleaming sleigh comes into view, pulled by powerful reindeer whose hooves pound and snort. Jack stammers in disbelief, cut off mid-sentence as one of the reindeer nearly knocks him over. North calls to the yetis, urging them to finish preparations quickly. Jack relents, agreeing to just one ride, and jumps into the sleigh. Sandy climbs in quietly behind him. North takes the reins, wrapping them around his arms, and turns to see Bunnymund standing frozen on the ground. North calls for him to board. Bunnymund hesitates, voicing concern about safety, then panics when he can't find seatbelts. With a laugh, North hoists him into the sleigh by sheer force and pulls him aboard.

He cracks the reins and shouts, 'Hyah!' The sleigh lurches forward, accelerating down a luge-like track. As they enter a corkscrew, North calls out to the others with a grin. Bunny clutches his seat, wide-eyed and shouting in fear. Jack laughs, thrown back by the force of the ride, clearly enjoying every moment. Sandy sits calmly in the back, unfazed, as the sleigh twists through the air and launches upward into the sky.

name: Jack's Tour of the Workshop
description: Jack follows North through the bustling factory floor, watching yetis carefully assemble and carry toys. As he takes in the activity, a toy duck suddenly whirs past his head, making him duck just in time. Ahead, elves zoom around on flying toys, testing them midair with uneven control. One group of elves gnaws on Christmas ornaments while another fumbles with tangled lights, sparking a small shock. North calls out praise as they pass, while yetis paint robots under his direction, one of them sighing as a batch of blue robots is ordered repainted red.

description: Jack walks behind North through the bustling factory, marveling at the sights. He watches a duck toy fly overhead and ducks just in time. 'Whoa! I always thought the elves made the toys,' he says. North turns slightly and whispers, 'We just let them believe that.' Keep up good work!'

name: North Shows Jack His Nesting Dolls
description: North takes a Russian nesting doll from a shelf and hands it to Jack. Jack twists the doll open, revealing a smaller one inside carved in North's likeness. He continues opening each doll, one after another, each revealing a smaller version of North with different expressions—jolly, mysterious, fearless, caring. Finally, Jack holds the last doll, no bigger than a jelly bean, and drops it into North's palm. North tells him to look closer. Jack examines the tiny figure and says it looks like a baby with big eyes. North nods and says his eyes are full of wonder—that is his center. As he speaks, the toys around the room come to life: jack-in-the-boxes pop, toy trains move, soldiers march, and planes fly through the air. name: Jack Confronts the Guardians After Being Challenged by Bunny
description: After the ceremonial celebration begins, Jack tries to leave, but Bunny stops him by saying no children believe in him. Jack pauses, then replies sarcastically, admitting it's true. He turns back toward the group, visibly frustrated. In retaliation, he mocks Bunny, calling him a kangaroo. Bunny bristles, offended, and corrects him, declaring he is the Easter Bunny and that children believe in him. The argument grows tense. Tooth steps in, moving between them to break it up. Nearby, Sandy notices the conflict is worsening and silently signals to North. North looks over, seeing the situation unfold.

name: North Pulls Jack Aside During Ceremony
description: As the celebration unfolds around him, Jack becomes increasingly overwhelmed and agitated. Bunny's continued hostility pushes the tension to a peak, prompting North to step in. He calls Jack aside, away from the crowd, the music, and the decorations, leading him to a quieter part of the room. The two stand apart from the others, the noise of the ceremony fading slightly as North begins to speak, his tone firm but calm.
